# Los Angeles Criminal Lawyer Pro

> Kraut Law Group's comprehensive criminal defense and DUI legal services across Los Angeles County, led by Harvard-educated managing attorney Michael E. Kraut.

This site serves as the primary web presence for Kraut Law Group Criminal & DUI Lawyers, Inc., offering criminal defense representation for serious felonies, DUI cases, and white-collar crimes throughout Los Angeles and Southern California. The firm features experienced trial attorneys with backgrounds in prosecution and specialized forensic expertise.
